(2) The context relocation in manual_context.build only triggers for stage==run_spec_author and execution_mode==sprint13b-execution. It scans the FULL composed instruction (git_publication.scan, which raises PUBLICATION_CONTENT_REJECTED on secrets) before replacing it with an inline mandatory pointer; all open obligations, policy, state, and operator docs remain verbatim inline via budget.assemble. (3) The installer repair moves the chown/chmod of history.parent and staged to 0:1003 0o550 to BEFORE the service-user verify postcheck. The fix grants group traversal consistent with the other archive directories without altering the permission model, credentials, or protected paths; it is gated behind inactive/failed service and no RUNNING calls.
